Rae T: Quick pasteable go-live mini-runbook for AEs — 1-screen.
Marco B: Short please.
Rae T: Steps: prefill top prompts -> reserve warm pool -> prime KV cache -> run two streaming checks -> watch renewal signals.
Jin L: Paste snippets below.
Jin L: Prefill (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant":"acme_inc","prompts":["welcome","help"],"limit":30}'
```
Jin L: Streaming smoke (curl SSE):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping","max_tokens":40}' "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-mini"
```
Marco B: Retry policy: expo backoff + full jitter, retries=3, base_ms=250, cap_ms=20000. Escalate to async queue if >25s cumulative latency.
Rae T: Renewal triggers to tag AE: sustained 5xx >2% baseline, >=15% drop in completion rate, repeated 429s first 72h, poor go-live feedback (<=3). Tag `renewal-risk` and book 15-min check.
ops-bot: prefill job started for acme_inc (job pf-900) ETA ~90s.
Rae T: TL;DR for AEs: prefill -> reserve warm pool -> smoke stream -> monitor -> capture feedback -> tag & engage.
